Package com.nexuslink.protocol.ldap

Class LdapService

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.ldap.LdapService
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class LdapService extends Object implements AutoCloseable
LDAP / Active Directory client over the UnboundID LDAP SDK. Connects (plain or LDAPS), optionally binds with a DN + password, reports the directory's naming contexts, and runs subtree/one-level/ base searches returning decoded entries. Blocking I/O — the UI drives it on a background task, mirroring the other protocol services.

The scopeOf(java.lang.String) mapping is a pure, unit-tested helper; the connect/search paths are tested end-to-end against UnboundID's bundled in-memory directory server (no external LDAP needed).

  • Method Details

    • connect

      public void connect(String host, int port, String bindDn, String password, boolean useSsl) throws com.unboundid.ldap.sdk.LDAPException, GeneralSecurityException
      Connects to host:port. When bindDn is blank the bind is anonymous. With useSsl true the connection is LDAPS and the server certificate is trusted blindly (NexusLink is a testing tool); set it false for plain LDAP / StartTLS-less connections.
      Throws:
      com.unboundid.ldap.sdk.LDAPException
      GeneralSecurityException

    • connect

      public void connect(String host, int port, String bindDn, String password, boolean useSsl, boolean startTls) throws com.unboundid.ldap.sdk.LDAPException, GeneralSecurityException
      As connect(String, int, String, String, boolean), but startTls upgrades a plain connection (usually port 389) to TLS with the RFC 4511 StartTLS extended operation before the bind, so credentials never cross the wire in the clear. StartTLS and LDAPS are mutually exclusive — useSsl wins and StartTLS is skipped.
      Throws:
      com.unboundid.ldap.sdk.LDAPException
      GeneralSecurityException

      public List<String> namingContexts() throws com.unboundid.ldap.sdk.LDAPException
      Returns the directory's naming contexts (subtree roots) read from the Root DSE — a natural starting point for the tree browser. Empty if the server doesn't publish them.
      Throws:
      com.unboundid.ldap.sdk.LDAPException

    • search

      public List<LdapService.Entry> search(String baseDn, String filter, String scope, int sizeLimit, String... attributes) throws com.unboundid.ldap.sdk.LDAPException
      Searches under baseDn with an RFC-4515 filter. scope is one of base, one, sub (case-insensitive). sizeLimit caps the result count (0 ⇒ server default). Pass attributes to restrict returned attributes, or none for all user attributes.
      Throws:
      com.unboundid.ldap.sdk.LDAPException

    • addEntry

      public void addEntry(String dn, Map<String,List<String>> attributes) throws com.unboundid.ldap.sdk.LDAPException
      Adds a new entry at dn with the given attributes (name → values). Values for each attribute are written in iteration order; an objectClass attribute is normally required by the server. Fails with LDAPException if the DN already exists or the data is invalid.
      Throws:
      com.unboundid.ldap.sdk.LDAPException

    • modifyEntry

      public void modifyEntry(String dn, List<LdapService.Mod> modifications) throws com.unboundid.ldap.sdk.LDAPException
      Applies attribute modifications (replace / add / delete) to the entry at dn in a single modify operation. Fails with LDAPException if the entry is missing or a change is rejected (e.g. deleting a non-existent value).
      Throws:
      com.unboundid.ldap.sdk.LDAPException

    • deleteEntry

      public void deleteEntry(String dn) throws com.unboundid.ldap.sdk.LDAPException
      Deletes the leaf entry at dn. Fails with LDAPException if it is missing or has children.
      Throws:
      com.unboundid.ldap.sdk.LDAPException

    • applyEntry

      public LdapService.ApplyResult applyEntry(String dn, Map<String,List<String>> attributes) throws com.unboundid.ldap.sdk.LDAPException
      Applies one LDIF-style entry to the directory: adds it at dn, or — when an entry already exists there — REPLACEs each supplied attribute's values on the existing entry (a re-import of the same DN updates it in place rather than failing). The DN itself is never renamed. Used by the LDIF import flow so a file mixing new and existing entries lands cleanly. Returns whether the entry was added or modified.
      Throws:
      com.unboundid.ldap.sdk.LDAPException
